## PresenceCapableBackend interface

Backend that can report its security [BackendCapabilities](./vaultkeeper.backendcapabilities.md) for its configured instance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface PresenceCapableBackend extends SecretBackend 
```
**Extends:** [SecretBackend](./vaultkeeper.secretbackend.md)

## Remarks

This is an optional extension interface, mirroring [ListableBackend](./vaultkeeper.listablebackend.md) and [SigningBackend](./vaultkeeper.signingbackend.md)<!-- -->: it is \*\*not\*\* a required member of [SecretBackend](./vaultkeeper.secretbackend.md)<!-- -->. Prefer [getBackendCapabilities()](./vaultkeeper.getbackendcapabilities.md) over calling [PresenceCapableBackend.getCapabilities()](./vaultkeeper.presencecapablebackend.getcapabilities.md) directly, so a backend that does not implement the interface safely defaults to no capabilities rather than being assumed to have them.

[PresenceCapableBackend.getCapabilities()](./vaultkeeper.presencecapablebackend.getcapabilities.md) is asynchronous and describes the \*\*current configured/live state\*\* of the instance — it must reflect configuration (or a live device/session probe) rather than a hardcoded per-type answer, and must not itself trigger a human-presence prompt.
